title: Help setting up the RGU Player with RPG Maker VX Ace

posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
So recently, I've been made aware of a tool for the Ruby-based RPG Maler games called the RGU Player. To give you an idea what it does, it basically uses OpenGL to run the game using the RGSS SDL as a bottom layer. With that, you can not only port the game easily to Linux and Android and also do stuff like changing the tile size, the resolution, etc.
Here's the link to said tool I've mentioned:
【RGU】RGSS全系跨平台运行时 Windows/Linux/Android - RPG Maker VX Ace 讨论区 -  Project1 -  Powered by Discuz!
Project1论坛，这里主要有RMXP、RMVX、AGM、RMVX ACE的制作交流区，游戏素材分享区和原创游戏发布区，以及其他一些版块，适合游戏制作爱好者一起参与讨论，共同进步，交流经验，分享成果。 ,Project1
rpg.blue
I've been trying to use it yesterday and set it up with a basic VX Ace project to test it, but I'm having some issues and confusion with it. Everything is in Chinese, so of course, I had to use Google Translate to understand what it's saying, but even then, I find it a bit confusing to set up.
I've been having issues of missing .ini files specific to the program and the versions I used, which I could've sworn it didn't come with the downloads I've tried even after searching the files (it has multiple versions for clarity, and I tried the official and latest versions of the tool), and setting it up I find it a bit confusing.
It says to select the version I want to use (x86 or x64) and remove the Win32App, which I wasn’t exactly sure how to do that, and then it says to use the RGU Console application that comes with the download but it has the same missing ini files problem I've just mentioned.
Ultimately, I'm left feeling confused and unsure how to do use it exactly. If anyone can help and tell me how to exactly use the RGU Player clearly and correctly and tell me what I was missing, I would appreciate that greatly. Thank you
